stem.text: The diagram is an external view of the mammalian heart and the associated blood vessels.

stem.alt: External view of a mammalian heart with associated blood vessels, with labelled vessels P, Q, R and S

stem.text: Which statement about the blood vessels associated with a normal, healthy heart is correct?

A.text: P and Q carry blood with more oxyhaemoglobin than haemoglobin.

B.text: P and R carry blood that is saturated with oxygen.

C.text: S and P carry blood with a low oxygen concentration.

D.text: S and R carry blood with more haemoglobin than oxyhaemoglobin.
